blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Current vision-language models (VLMs) excel at visual content understanding and text-based reasoning, yet their structure limits the advancement of incorporating images into the reasoning chain.
Though Omnimodal models have made efforts in unifying text and image generation, they focus on visual tasks in the open-domain, lacking tractability due to rasterized or latent representations of images.
We introduce SVGLM, a framework that uses scalable vector graphics (SVG) primitives to connect text and image in reasoning tasks.
We exploit the duality of SVG as both image description and text instructions, yielding a more compact, interpretable solution to equip general VLMs with the capability of generating images within the reasoning process. We provide a large curated dataset of SVG-based image editing dataset, as well as the paradigm to tune open-source VLMs. Experiments on a mathematical reasoning benchmark demonstrate that SVGLM achieves strong SVG generation power as well as think-with-image intelligence. Our results highlight SVG as a suitable medium for building more robust digital domain agents, bridging the gap between text-based thinking and pixel-based images.
blocks.zh:
目前的视觉语言模型(VLMs)在视觉内容理解和基于文字的推理方面表现优异,然而其结构限制了将图像融入推理链的进步.
虽然Omnimodule模型在统一文本和图像生成方面做出了努力,但它们侧重于开放域的视觉任务,由于图像的光栅化或潜在表现而缺乏可引导性。
我们引入了SVGLM,这个框架在推理任务中使用可伸缩矢量图形(SVG)原始数据连接文本和图像.
我们利用SVG的双重性,既作为图像描述,又作为文本指示,产生更紧凑,可解释的解决方案,使一般VLM具备在推理过程中生成图像的能力. 我们提供了基于SVG的图像编辑数据集的大型编译数据集,以及调谐开源VLM的范式. 关于数学推理基准的实验表明,SVGLM实现了强大的SVG发电功率以及思维-图像智能. 我们的成果突出了SVG是一个合适的媒介,可以构建更强大的数字域代理,弥合基于文本的思维和基于像素的图像之间的差距.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison between standard multi-modal chain-of-thought and SVG-enhanced thinking. Vanilla SFT and SVGLM yield different conversation patterns and results. SVGLM offers a more robust thinking with images pipeline with better performance on reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 图1:标准多模式思维链与SVG增强思维的比较. 香草SFT和SVGLM产生不同的对话模式和结果. SVGLM为图像管道提供了更强的思维,在推理任务上表现更好.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs; Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Team et al., 2023 ; OpenAI, 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 , inter alia ) have demonstrated promising performance in a range of downstream tasks ( Yue et al., 2024 ) , serving as an important building block of physical intelligence ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Zitkovich et al., 2023 ; Nasiriany et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs;拉德福德等人,2021年;Alayrac等人,2022年;Team等人,2023年;OpenAI,2024年;Wang等人,2024年等)在一系列下游任务中表现出了有希望的表现(Yue等人,2024年),成为物理智能的重要基石(黄等人,2022年;Zitkovich等人,2023年;Nasiriyany等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
However, two limitations remain salient for digital intelligence, where the visual input is often a graphical artifact rather than a natural photo.
First, current VLMs still struggle with infographics such as mathematical diagrams, charts, and structured visual documents ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) .
These inputs compress symbolic structure, quantitative relations, and latent constraints into a small number of marks and coordinates.
In many cases, the model must understand the graphical structures behind the figure (e.g., axes, scales, layout rules) before reliable reasoning is possible.
Second, even when VLMs produce long and fluent rationales, the intermediate steps are frequently weakly grounded in the visual evidence ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
As a result, their conclusions can be dominated by linguistic priors and pattern completion rather than verified visual computation.
This becomes acute in tasks where the missing ingredient is an explicit visual operation, e.g., adding an auxiliary line in geometry, where text-only reasoning is insufficient without an externalizable, checkable visual substrate.
blocks.zh:
然而,数字智能仍然有两个显著的局限性,即视觉输入往往是图形文物而不是自然照片.
第一,目前的VLM仍然与数学图,图表,结构化视觉文件等图象发生斗争(刘等人,2023年;唐等人,2025年;沈等人,2025年).
这些投入将象征结构、数量关系和潜在制约压缩为少量标记和坐标。
在许多情况下,模型必须先了解图背后的图形结构(如轴,秤,布局规则),然后才有可能进行可靠的推理.
第二,即使VLM产生长而流利的理由,中间步骤也往往薄弱于视觉证据(姚等人,2025年;刘等人,2025年;张等人,2025年a).
因此,他们的结论可以以语言学前科和图案完成为主,而不是经过核实的视觉计算.
这在缺失的成分是显性视觉操作的任务中变得尖锐,例如,在几何学中添加一条辅助线条,在没有可外观,可核查的视觉底物的情况下,仅文本推理是不够的.

blocks.en:
Instead of relying on human-provided prompts, OpenAI (2025) ’s Thinking with Images paradigm turns the image into an active workspace, where intermediate visual states are created and manipulated to support reasoning.
Recent frameworks ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Duan et al., 2025 ; Qiao et al., 2025 ) operationalize this idea by treating visual manipulations as part of the reasoning process, e.g., generating auxiliary lines, marks, or plots as explicit intermediate steps.
While some works aim to internalize such manipulations in latent space ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , explicit visual rationales remain attractive for interpretability and verifiability, especially in geometric and mathematical settings where step-by-step correction matters.
blocks.zh:
OpenAI(2025年)用图像范式思考, 将图像转化为活跃的工作空间,
最近的框架(Hu et al.,2024;Duan et al.,2025;Qiao et al.,2025)将视觉操纵作为推理过程的一部分,例如生成辅助线,标记,或地块作为明确的中间步骤来实施这个想法.
虽然有些作品旨在将潜伏空间中的这种操纵内部化(Zhang等人,2025b); Zhang et al., 2025a;Wang et al., 2025a),清晰的视觉原理对于可解释性和可核查性仍然具有吸引力,特别是在几何和数学环境中,分步修正很重要.

blocks.en:
A practical question is the representation used to externalize these visual steps.
Many existing systems either (i) generate raster or latent images, or (ii) generate imperative Python code that renders and edits figures.
The former can be token-inefficient when interleaving high-resolution visual artifacts over long horizons, and the latter tightly couples reasoning to specific software stacks and runtime environments, which can be brittle under version drift and dependency changes.
For instance, VIGA and RECODE rely on Python programs executed in graphics engines or plotting tool chains for iterative render-and-revise loops ( Yin et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2025 ) ; CodePlot-CoT and DeepSketcher further train models to emit such code-based visual steps for geometry-centric reasoning ( Duan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
In contrast, renderable programs like Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) offer a declarative, hierarchical, and resolution-independent interface: models can operate directly on compositional primitives (paths, shapes, groups, text) via structured text, making each visual modification both grounded and editable ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Rodriguez et al., 2025 ) .
This makes SVG a natural medium for visual reasoning as executable rationale: editable by construction, verifiable by rendering, and expressive enough to encode geometric structure without committing to heavyweight generation or tooling.
blocks.zh:
一个实际的问题是这些视觉步骤外部化时所使用的表示.
许多现有系统要么(一)生成光栅或潜伏图像,要么(二)生成使数字产生和编辑数字的必备Python代码.
前者在将高清晰度的视觉文物跨过长视野时可以成为象征性的无效物,后者则紧密地将夫妇推理到特定的软件堆栈和运行时环境,在版本漂移和依赖性变化下,这种推理可能很不合理.
例如,VIGA和RECODE依靠在图形引擎或绘图工具链中执行的Python程序进行迭代渲染和复制循环(Yin等人,2026年;Shen等人,2025年);代码 Plot-CoT和DeepSketcher进一步培训模型,以释放出这种基于密码的视觉步骤,用于几何-以几何为中心的推理(Duan等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年a).
相比之下,可缩放矢量图形(SVG)等可渲染程序提供了一个宣示性,分级性和分辨率独立的界面:模型可以通过结构化文本直接在组成原始物(路径,形状,组,文本)上运行,使每次视觉修改都同时被固定和编辑(杨等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年b;罗德里格斯等人,2025年).
这使得SVG成为视觉推理作为可执行理由的自然媒介:通过构造可以编辑,通过渲染可以可核查,并且表达力足以编码几何结构而无需承诺重力生成或工具化.

blocks.en: In this work, we present SVGLM, a SVG-enhanced reasoning paradigm to facilitate multimodal reasoning of VLMs, a paradigm to incorporate SVG as part of the thinking process into current vision language models (VLMs). Our contribution is summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了SVGLM,这是一种促进VLMs多式联运推理的SVG增强推理范式,是一种将SVG作为思维过程的一部分纳入当前视觉语言模型(VLM)的范式. 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We present a high-quality, LLM-verified dataset of SVG-as-image-editing samples with 8K samples. • We propose the first scheme to enhance multi-modal thinking with images rendered from vector programs. • We show that proper SVG integration achieves superior performance on trending multi-modal agents in solving downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出了一套高质量、经LLM验证的SVG-as-image-edition样本,有8K样本。 我们提议采用第一个方案,利用从矢量程序获得的图像,加强多式联运思维。 我们表明,在解决下游任务方面,适当的SVG一体化在使多式联运代理商趋势化方面取得了优异的业绩。

blocks.en: We present a high-quality, LLM-verified dataset of SVG-as-image-editing samples with 8K samples.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一套高质量的LLM验证数据集,其中包含8K个样本的SVG-as-image-edition.

blocks.en: We propose the first scheme to enhance multi-modal thinking with images rendered from vector programs.
blocks.zh: 我们建议采用第一个方案,利用从矢量程序生成的图像,加强多模式思维。

blocks.en: We show that proper SVG integration achieves superior performance on trending multi-modal agents in solving downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们表明,在解决下游任务方面,适当的SVG一体化在使多式联运代理商趋势化方面取得了优异的业绩。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Representation by Graphics Programs
blocks.zh: 2.1 图形方案的视觉表现

blocks.en:
A growing body of research has moved towards representing visual content through the lens of structured, editable graphics programs. Recent frameworks like VIGA ( Yin et al., 2026 ) and RECODE ( Shen et al., 2025 ) reconstruct images as executable programs, enabling a "write-run-render-compare-revise" loop to ensure geometric consistency.
While VIGA leverages the deterministic nature of 3D engines such as Blender to bridge the semantic gap, RECODE focuses on decomposing visual content into 2D programmatic abstractions.
Complementing these programmatic approaches, recent works ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Rodriguez et al., 2025 ) leverage Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) for visual content generation.
Unlike rasterized pixels or the imperative code often used in general program synthesis, SVG provides a declarative, hierarchical, and resolution-independent representation.
This nature renders SVG an ideal medium for visual reasoning, as it allows models to manipulate high-level primitives (e.g., paths, shapes) directly through structured text, ensuring that every visual modification is inherently grounded in a verifiable and editable format.
blocks.zh:
越来越多的研究通过结构化的,可编辑的图形程序的透镜来体现视觉内容。 最近的一些框架,如VIGA(Yin等人,2026年)和RECODE(Shen等人,2025年),将图像重建为可执行程序,使得能有一个"write-run-render-compare-revise"循环,以确保几何一致性.
虽然VIGA利用Blender等3D引擎的定型性质来弥补语义差距,但RECODE专注于将视觉内容分解为2D程序抽象.
作为这些方案方法的补充,最近的一些著作(杨等人,2025年;吴等人,2025年b;罗德里格斯等人,2025年)利用可伸缩的矢量图形生成视觉内容。
与光栅化像素或一般程序合成中常用的必备代码不同,SVG提供了一种宣示性,层次性和分辨率独立的表示.
这种性质使得SVG成为视觉推理的理想媒介,因为它允许模型直接通过结构化的文本来操纵高层次的原始(如路径,形状),确保每个视觉修改本质上都基于可核查和可编辑的格式.

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual Prompts and Thinking with Images
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉提示和图像思维

blocks.en:
VLMs exhibit visually grounded understanding of user-provided visual cues, motivating visual prompting ( Yang et al., 2023a ; Yang et al., 2023b ; Feng et al., 2025 ) .
Early work relied on tuning-based approaches ( Bahng et al., 2022 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) , while later studies showed that VLMs can follow such cues zero-shot, e.g., overlaid marks and text ( Shtedritski et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023b ; Li et al., 2023b ; Yang et al., 2023a ) .
A series of training-free methods have been proposed ( Lei et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wan et al., 2024 ) , and recent work further strengthens visual prompting via visual instruction tuning ( Cai et al., 2024 ) or explicit pointer tokens ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
Instead of relying on human-provided prompts, OpenAI (2025) ’s Thinking with Images paradigm transforms it into an active workspace where visual elements are dynamically manipulated to aid reasoning.
Recent frameworks such as Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) , CodePlot-CoT ( Duan et al., 2025 ) , and V-Thinker ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) formalize visual prompts as a part of Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
In these systems, models explicitly generate auxiliary lines, marks, or plots to externalize intermediate reasoning steps.
While some recent works attempt to internalize this process into latent space ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025a ) , explicit Visual CoT offers distinct advantages in interpretability and precision, particularly for geometric and mathematical tasks.
By externalizing the rationale onto a visual canvas, explicit methods allow for step-by-step verification and correction, a property essential for rigorous reasoning.
blocks.zh:
VLMs展现了对用户提供的视觉提示的基于视觉的理解,激发视觉提示(Yang等人,2023a); Yang等人,2023b; Feng等人,2025).
早期的工作依赖于基于调制的方法(Bahng等人,2022年;Yao等人,2024年),而后来的研究表明,VLM可以遵循这种提示的零射法,例如,覆盖标记和文字(Shtedritski等人,2023年;Yang等人,2023年b;Li等人,2023年b;Yang等人,2023年a).
提出了一系列无培训方法(Lei等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年;Wan等人,2024年),近期的工作进一步加强了通过视觉指示调音(Cai等人,2024年)或明确指针符号(Lai等人,2024年;张等人,2024年)的视觉提示.
OpenAI(2025年)的“用影像思考”范式将它转变为一个活跃的工作空间, 视觉元素被动态操纵,
最近的框架,如Visual Sketchpad(Hu等人,2024年),代码 绘图 (Duan等人,2025年),和V-Thinker(Qiao等人,2025年)将视觉提示正式化,作为"思链"推理的一部分.
在这些系统中,模型明确生成辅助线,标记,或图案,使中间推理步骤外部化.
最近的一些工作试图将这一过程内部化为潜在的空间(Zhang等人,2025b); Zhang等人,2025a;Wang等人,2025a),明确视觉 CoT在可解释性和精确性方面提供了显著的优势,特别是在几何和数学任务方面.
通过将理由外部化到视觉上,明确的方法允许逐步核查和纠正,这是严格推理所必需的。

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual Reasoning with Code
blocks.zh: 2.3 视觉理由与代码

blocks.en: Visual reasoning via code generation leverages the modularity and precise logic of programming to address the compositional limitations inherent in end-to-end vision models. Early approaches ( Surís et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) facilitated this by composing vision models through generated Python subroutines. However, these methods are often constrained by a static, predefined library of vision modules, limiting their adaptability to novel tasks. More recently, agentic frameworks like PyVision ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) and OpenThinkImg ( Su et al., 2025 ) extend this by enabling MLLMs to synthesize bespoke Python tools for specific queries, grounding reasoning in executable code to handle complex geometric and document-based tasks. However, such general-purpose imperative code often abstracts geometric details behind procedural logic (e.g., hiding coordinates within variables or loops), creating a disconnect between the symbolic code and the actual spatial layout. This contrasts with SVG, which enforces explicit definitions of geometric attributes directly in the text, thereby intrinsically aligning the reasoning process with the visual result.
blocks.zh: 通过代码生成的视觉推理利用了编程的模块性和精确逻辑,以解决端到端视觉模型固有的组成局限性. 早期方法(Surís等人,2023年;Hu等人,2024年)通过生成的Python子例程编组视觉模型,促进了这一点。 然而,这些方法往往受到一个静态的,预设的视觉模块库的限制,使其适应性局限于新任务. 最近,诸如PyVision(赵等人,2025年)和OpenThinkImg(Su等人,2025年)等代理框架通过使MLLMs能够合成用于特定查询的Python语工具,在可执行代码中进行推理,以处理复杂的几何和基于文档的任务,从而扩展了这一点。 然而,这种通用的强制代码常常在程序逻辑背后摘要几何细节(例如,在变量或环路内隐藏坐标),造成符号代码与实际空间布局脱节. 这与SVG形成对比,SVG直接在文本中执行几何属性的明确定义,从而在本质上使推理过程与视觉结果一致.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Our data curation pipeline. We use Gemini-3-Pro to identify the difference between source and target images and generate SVGs. Both GPT filtering and human verification are conducted to ensure the quality of collected samples.
blocks.zh: 图2:我们的数据整理程序。 我们使用双子座-3-Pro来识别源与目标图像的区别并生成SVG. 进行GPT过滤和人类核查,以确保所收集样品的质量。

blocks.en: 3.1 Scalable Vector Graphics as Programs
blocks.zh: 3.1 可缩放矢量图形作为程序

blocks.en: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) ( Dahlström et al., 2011 ) is an XML-based vector graphics format used widely in icons, webpages, etc. It encodes scalable shapes, figures and texts into XML objects, where each entity is either a special object such as text or an embedded image, or a generic “path” formed by specifying the starting point and moving patterns. Tools like VTracer ( VTracer, 2026 ) can decompose and encode any pixel-based image into SVG programs with arbitrary granularity, showing that SVG has ample visual representation power. Commercial language models like Gemini 3 ( DeepMind, 2025 ) have shown strong abilities in understanding and generating SVGs consisting of simple shapes. These cases prove SVG as a bridge connecting XML-like text and free-form images.
blocks.zh: 可缩放矢量图形(SVG)(Dahlström et al., 2011)是一种基于XML的矢量图形格式,广泛用于图标,网页等. 它将可缩放的形状,数字和文本编码为XML对象,其中每个实体要么是文字等特殊对象,要么是嵌入的图像,要么是通过指定起始点和移动模式形成的通用"路径". VTracher(VTracher, 2026)等工具可以以任意的颗粒性将任何基于像素的图像分解并编码为SVG程序,显示SVG具有充分的视觉表现力. 双子座3(DeepMind,2025年)等商业语言模型在理解和生成由简单形状组成的SVG方面表现出了强大的能力. 这些案例证明SVG是连接XML类似文本和自由形式图像的桥梁.

blocks.en: In our work, we utilize SVG as a tool to effectively quantize and visualize the multi-modal thinking process. We emphasize vital properties of the connection between SVG and its rendered image: grounded , as entities like lines and rectangles in SVG will be clearly referenced in the resulting image; editable , since human and language model agents can easily manipulate SVG programs from XML-tree level without paying extra attention to grammatical or algorithmic failures; semantically meaningful , rising from the explicit coordinate representations of each entity in the XML codes in SVG. These properties are crucial in our application where multi-modal agents generate SVG code as part of the thinking process, while the deterministically rendered image from the given SVG is sent back to the agent, consistent with the standard multi-modal conversation pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在我们的工作中,我们利用SVG作为一种工具,有效地量化和直观地看待多式联运思维进程。 我们强调SVG与其渲染的图像之间联系的重要属性: 被定位,因为SVG中的线条和矩形等实体会在生成的图像中被明确引用; 可编辑 ,因为人和语言模型代理可以轻松地从XML-tree级别操纵SVG程序,而不对语法或算法故障给予额外的关注; 集合意义,从SVG中的XML代码中每个实体的明显坐标表示中上升. 这些特性对我们的应用至关重要,即多式联运代理作为思维过程的一部分生成SVG代码,而从给定的SVG中决定性生成的图像则被送回代理,符合标准的多式联运对话管道.

blocks.en: 3.2 Thinking with Renderable Programs
blocks.zh: 3.2 与可修改程序进行思考

blocks.en: Modern vision-language models excel at understanding semantic visual information, but are not naturally equipped with multi-modal generation abilities. This limits their performance in tasks that require active visual editing and thinking based on the modified images. Omni models like Bagel ( Deng et al., 2025 ) support multi-modal generation through unified pre-training, but lack the power to accurately reflect the thinking process in open-domain image editing. In our work, SVG is used as the medium bridging text-based thinking, which vision-language models are good at, and creating intermediate images that help chain-of-thought thinking. The structure of SVG programs allows surprisingly simple descriptions of standard figures on top of the canvas image, making it suitable for downstream tasks such as plotting and captioning crucial entities in complex visual understanding, or drawing auxiliary lines and shapes within the digital domain.
blocks.zh: 现代视觉语言模型擅长理解语义视觉信息,但并非自然具备多模式生成能力. 这限制了他们在需要基于修改后的图像进行主动视觉编辑和思考的任务中的性能. Bagel(Deng等人,2025年)等Omni模型通过统一预训支持多模式生成,但缺乏在开放域图像编辑中准确反映思维过程的能力. 在我们的作品中,SVG被作为中间的桥接文字思维,视觉语言模型擅长这种思维,并创建帮助思维链的中间图像. SVG程序的结构允许在画布图像上方对标准数字进行出乎意料的简单描述,使其适合下游的任务,比如在复杂的视觉理解中绘制和字幕关键实体,或在数字域内绘制辅助线条和形状.

blocks.en: We introduce Scalable-Vector-Graphics-enhanced Language Models (SVGLM) to boost vision language models’ multi-step reasoning abilities. We adopt the standard multi-turn tool-calling scheme, but allow normal text generation before the tool call. More precisely, the model can evoke a tool-call by wrapping arguments inside ‘<tool_call>’ and ‘< \ \backslash tool_call>’ tokens any time during its generation process. The calling arguments include XML-encoded SVG and a specification of the image to be used as canvas, which can be either the question image or blank. Figure 1 shows a simplified interaction process, where the agent chooses to either render a new SVG or answer the original question in each turn of the conversation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了可伸缩-维克托-格莱菲克斯-增强语言模型(SVGLM)来提升视觉语言模型的多步骤推理能力. 我们采用标准的多回合工具调用方案,但在工具调用前允许正常的文本生成. 更确切地说,该模型可以通过在生成过程中的任何时候将参数包在 QQtool_call_和\\\backslash工具_call_Qall%中来触发工具调用。 调用参数包括XML-encoded SVG和用作画布的图像的规格,可以是问题图像,也可以是空白. 图1显示了一个简化的交互过程,即代理商选择在对话的每个回合中要么做出一个新的SVG,要么回答原来的问题.

blocks.en: Our SVGLM pipeline can work seamlessly with any open-source trainable multi-modal agent. To empower any agent with renderable programs, we construct an 8K dataset of high-quality SVG tool-calling samples, which will be organized in conversation format consistent with the interactive reasoning pipeline mentioned above. A standard supervised fine-tuning is then conducted on each model to learn the structure and semantic relationship of SVGs. More detailed data collection and training are described in Section 3.3 and Section 4.2 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们的SVGLM管道可以无缝地与任何开源可培训的多式联运代理商合作。 为了赋予任何代理以可渲染程序的能力,我们构建了一个8K的高质量SVG工具调用样本数据集,该数据集将以与上述交互推理管道一致的对话形式组织. 然后在每个模型上进行标准监督微调,以学习SVG的结构和语义关系. 第3.3节和第4.2节分别介绍了更详细的数据收集和培训情况。

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据校正

blocks.en: To equip VLMs with SVG reasoning ability, we curated a dataset consisting of 8,000 high-quality SVGs for drawing auxiliary lines in geometric problems. We use original images from MathCanvas-Instruct ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , a large collection of multi-modal QA pairs where a “solution image” is crucial to answer the question. We select the plane geometry and solid geometry splits, as these categories have more samples that necessitates canvas-based geometric constructions instead of drawing from scratch.
blocks.zh: 为了让VLMs具有SVG推理能力,我们整理了一个由8000个优质SVG组成的数据集,用于绘制几何问题中的辅助线条. 我们使用MathCanvas-Instruct(Shi等人,2025年)的原始图像,这是一大批多式QA配对,其中“解决方案图像”对回答问题至关重要。 我们选择平面几何和固态几何分裂,因为这些类别有更多的样本,需要基于帆布的几何构造,而不是从零开始绘制.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 2 , our SVG data collection pipeline proceeded in three stages: • First, we employ GPT-5 to filter the source dataset, leaving problems where the solution image can be constructed from the question image by only adding captions and drawing new figures. • Second, Gemini-3.0-Thinking is used to construct precise SVG annotations corresponding to intermediate visual steps. We let Gemini identify the difference between the question image and solution image, while accurately plotting each keypoint’s location on a 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 canvas. We choose Gemini-3.0-Thinking over GPT-5 as Gemini demonstrates stronger abilities in accurately deciding keypoint coordinates. • Finally, we render generated SVGs onto original question images, and utilize GPT-5 as a visual verifier to assess the quality of the synthesis. Only samples with verified visual accuracy were retained.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们的SVG数据收集管道分三个阶段进行: 第一,我们使用GPT-5过滤源数据集,仅通过添加标题和绘制新数字就可以在问题图像中构建解决方案图像留下问题。 • 第二,双子座-3.0-思维用于构造精确的SVG说明,对应中间视觉步骤. 我们让双子座识别出问题图像和溶液图像之间的区别,同时准确绘制每个关键点在1000×1000×1000\时1000画布上的位置. 我们选择双子座-3.0- 考虑GPT-5,因为双子座显示出更有能力准确决定关键点坐标. • 支助 最后,我们把生成的SVG制成原始的问题图像,并利用GPT-5作为视觉验证器来评估合成的质量。 仅保留经核实的视觉精度样本。

blocks.en: First, we employ GPT-5 to filter the source dataset, leaving problems where the solution image can be constructed from the question image by only adding captions and drawing new figures.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们使用GPT-5过滤源数据集,仅通过添加标题和绘制新数字就可以使解析图像从问题图像中构建出来的问题留下.

blocks.en: Second, Gemini-3.0-Thinking is used to construct precise SVG annotations corresponding to intermediate visual steps. We let Gemini identify the difference between the question image and solution image, while accurately plotting each keypoint’s location on a 1000 × 1000 1000\times 1000 canvas. We choose Gemini-3.0-Thinking over GPT-5 as Gemini demonstrates stronger abilities in accurately deciding keypoint coordinates.
blocks.zh: 第二,双子座-3.0-思维用于构建与中间视觉步骤相对应的精确SVG说明. 我们让双子座识别出问题图像和溶液图像之间的区别,同时准确绘制每个关键点在1000×1000×1000\时1000画布上的位置. 我们选择双子座-3.0- 考虑GPT-5,因为双子座显示出更有能力准确决定关键点坐标.

blocks.en: Finally, we render generated SVGs onto original question images, and utilize GPT-5 as a visual verifier to assess the quality of the synthesis. Only samples with verified visual accuracy were retained.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们把生成的SVG制成原始的问题图像,并利用GPT-5作为视觉验证器来评估合成的质量。 仅保留经核实的视觉精度样本。

blocks.en: Table 1: Human evaluation results in percentage.
blocks.zh: 表1:人类评价结果百分比。

blocks.en: To verify the quality of our collected samples, we conduct human evaluations on a random subset of our collected samples, asking if the constructed SVG reflects the shift between the question image and the solution image, as well as the accuracy of key points used by the SVG. We classify each sample into one of: perfect reconstruction, slight translational error, major translational error, and structural error, since translational discrepancy is not catastrophic in SVG generation. Evaluation percentages are indicated in Table 1 , showing only 1 % 1\% of all evaluated samples have structural errors, thus confirming our dataset’s quality.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们所收集样品的质量,我们对我们所收集样品的一个随机子集进行人类评价,询问所构建的SVG是否反映了问题图像和溶液图像之间的转变,以及SVG所使用的关键点的准确性. 我们把每个样本分为:完美重建,微小翻译错误,重大翻译错误和结构错误,因为翻译差异在SVG生成中并不是灾难性的. 表1显示评价百分比,显示所有被评价样本中只有1%的1%有结构错误,从而证实了我们数据集的质量。

blocks.en: For the multi-modal models’ usage, we generate proper reasoning and tool calling with GPT-5, which is given a complete description and solution of each question, as well as the curated SVG and rendered image. We construct three different levels of reasoning density: no reasoning, concise reasoning and complete reasoning to suit different abilities of the target models. All generated messages are properly tokenized and organized to form our 3 3 -level SVG-enhanced conversation dataset.
blocks.zh: 对于多种模式的使用,我们用GPT-5生成适当的推理和工具,而GPT-5对每个问题都作了完整的描述和解决,还生成了经过整理的SVG和图像。 我们构建了三个不同层次的推理密度:没有推理,简洁推理和完整的推理来适应目标模型的不同能力. 所有生成的信息都经过适当的标记和整理,形成我们3个3级的SVG增强的对话数据集.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Table 2: Comparative evaluation of multi-modal agents on MathCanvas-Bench. Scores represent weighted accuracy. Best results within each model family are highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表2:对MathCanvas-Bench的多式联运剂的比较评价。 分数代表加权精确度。 强调了每个模范家庭的最佳成果。

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset and Metric
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和计量

blocks.en: We use MathCanvas-Bench ( Shi et al., 2025 ) as the benchmark to evaluate reasoning ability that benefits from drawing auxiliary lines. MathCanvas-Bench consists of 3000 question-answer pairs over 8 math categories that require multi-step visual thinking, each of which consists of one to three sub-questions. We select Plane Geometry (1092 samples) and Solid Geometry (486 samples) from the benchmark’s splits for evaluation, in accordance with our curated dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MathCanvas-Bench(Shi等人,2025年)作为基准,评价从绘制辅助线中受益的推理能力. MathCanvas-Bench由8个数学类的3000个问答对组成,需要多步视觉思维,每个分题由1到3个子问题组成. 我们根据我们整理的数据集,从基准的分数中挑选几何(1092个样本)和固体几何(486个样本)进行评估。

blocks.en: To reflect rendering images on a canvas, we filter only samples from the above benchmark with at least one image in question, leaving a total of 1244 (78.8%) QA pairs. We report accuracy over both categories, as well as a weighted overall score. Following MathCanvas-Bench, we calculate accuracy with weighted scoring that rewards correct answers of later sub-questions more heavily, where each sub-question’s weight is 30 % 30\% larger than the previous sub-question.
blocks.zh: 为了在画布上反射渲染图像,我们从上述基准中过滤出至少一个图像的样本,总共留下1244对(78.8%)的QA对. 我们报告这两个类别的准确性以及加权总分。 在MathCanvas-Bench之后,我们用加权评分计算精确度,奖励对后来的子问题的正确回答,每个子问题的权重比以前的子问题大30%。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation setting
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价设置

blocks.en: We select 3 3 open-source models of roughly the same size: LLaVa-Next-Mistral-7B ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and InternVL-3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Despite similar scale and architectures, these models vary in zero-shot abilities like multi-step mathematical reasoning and SVG generation. All selected models are tested against three settings: • Zero-shot : The models are given the original question and image without training. They then answer each question after Chain-of-Thought thinking ( Wei et al., 2022 ) . • SFT : We collect questions from MathCanvas-Instruct ( Shi et al., 2025 ) as user messages with the same number of samples as our SVG-enhanced conversation dataset. GPT-5-generated chain-of-thought reasoning is conducted with rejection-sampling using questions from MathCanvas-Instruct, after which supervised-finetuning is applied on each model. • SVGLM : Selected models are fine-tuned on our SVG-enhanced conversation dataset, respectively. All models are evaluated in the interactive tool-calling paradigm on MathCanvas-Bench.
blocks.zh: 我们选择大小大致相同的3个开源模型: LLaVa-Next-Mistral-7B (意大利语) (Liu等人,2024年),Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令(Bai等人,2025b)和InternVL-3-8B(Zhu等人,2025年). 尽管规模和架构相似,但这些模型在多步数学推理和SVG生成等零射能力上有所不同. 所有选取的模型都通过三种设置进行测试: ^ 零拍:这些模型在不经过训练的情况下获得原题和图像. 随后,他们又在思考链(Wei et al., 2022)之后回答了每个问题. ^ SFT:我们从MathCanvas-Instruct(Shi et al., 2025)收集问题,作为用户信息,样本数量与我们的SVG增强对话数据集相同. GPT-5生成的思维链推理是利用MathCanvas-Instruct的提问进行拒绝抽样,然后在每个模型上应用有监督的精细调试. • SVGLM:我们SVG增强的谈话数据集分别对选定的模型进行了微调。 在MathCanvas-Bench的交互式工具调用范式中对所有模型进行评价。

blocks.en: Zero-shot : The models are given the original question and image without training. They then answer each question after Chain-of-Thought thinking ( Wei et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 0射门 : 模型在未经训练的情况下获得原题和形象. 然后,他们在思考链(Wei et al., 2022)之后回答每个问题.

blocks.en: SFT : We collect questions from MathCanvas-Instruct ( Shi et al., 2025 ) as user messages with the same number of samples as our SVG-enhanced conversation dataset. GPT-5-generated chain-of-thought reasoning is conducted with rejection-sampling using questions from MathCanvas-Instruct, after which supervised-finetuning is applied on each model.
blocks.zh: SFT:我们从MathCanvas-Instruct(Shi等人,2025年)收集问题,作为用户消息,样本数量与我们的SVG增强对话数据集相同. GPT-5生成的思维链推理是利用MathCanvas-Instruct的提问进行拒绝抽样,然后在每个模型上应用有监督的精细调试.

blocks.en: SVGLM : Selected models are fine-tuned on our SVG-enhanced conversation dataset, respectively. All models are evaluated in the interactive tool-calling paradigm on MathCanvas-Bench.
blocks.zh: SVGLM : 我们的SVG增强对话数据集分别对所选模型进行了微调. 在MathCanvas-Bench的交互式工具调用范式中对所有模型进行评价。

blocks.en: Each separate SFT experiment is conducted with 3 epochs, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} and batch size 8 8 on 8 NVIDIA-H100 GPUs. Running time of different models varies slightly, but all experiments can finish after 2 2 hours. Detailed training setups are described in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 每个单独的SFT实验都是用3个纪元,学习率10−5 10×5}和8 NVIDIA-H100 GPU上的批量尺寸8 8进行. 不同模型的运行时间略有不同,但所有实验可以在2个2小时后完成. 详细的培训设置见附录。

blocks.en: We also select several baseline methods for comparison as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们还选择了以下几种基准方法进行比较:

blocks.en: V-Thinker ( Qiao et al., 2025 ) uses python coding as tool-based visual chain-of-thought. We use the officially released pre-trained model and pipeline of V-Thinker on our dataset.
blocks.zh: V-Thinker(Qiao等人,2025年)使用python编码作为基于工具的视觉链思维. 我们使用官方发布的 V -Thinker的预训模型和管道 在我们的数据集。

blocks.en: Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) is an open-source image editing model. We use GPT-4o as the backbone to generate clear image editing instructions such as "connect A and B in this image", whose result is then fed into Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 along with the starting canvas to synthesize an image. This is analogous to the SVGLM pipeline with GPT-4o’s instructions replacing SVG generation and Qwen-Image-Edit replacing the SVG renderer.
blocks.zh: Quen-Image-Edit(Wu等人,2025a)是一个开源图像编辑模型. 我们使用GPT-4o作为骨干,生成清晰的图像编辑指示,如"在这个图像中连接A和B",其结果随后与开始的画布一起输入Quen-Image-Edit-2511,以合成一个图像. 这与SVGLM管道类似,GPT-4o的指令取代了SVG生成,Quen-Image-Edit取代了SVG渲染器.

blocks.en: Commercial models We evaluate GPT-4o under the zero-shot setting to illustrate the difficulty of the MathCanvas benchmark.
blocks.zh: 商业模式 我们在零镜头设定下评价GPT-4o,以说明MathCanvas基准的难度.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generated SVGs
blocks.zh: 4.3 生成的 SVG

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Instruction and SVG generated by SVGLM, as well as Qwen-Image-Edit and Nano Banana on the exact same prompt
blocks.zh: 图 3: SVGLM生成的指令和SVG,以及Quen-Image-Edit和Nano Banana在完全相同的即时

blocks.en: We show qualitative results of reconstructed SVGs from our trained models in Figure 3 , along with image editing results from both Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and Nano-Banana ( Google, 2026 ) with the same instruction. We can see that large image editing models such as Qwen-Image-Edit or Nano-Banana suffer from severe hallucination and domain misalignment, making it difficult to follow the text instructions. Moreover, fine-tuning on diffusion-based image editing models requires significantly more data compared to standard VLM fine-tuning, which blocks the path of adapting them to efficient thinking with images.
blocks.zh: 在图3中,我们从训练有素的模型中展示了重建SVG的质量结果,以及Quen-Image-Edit(Wu等人,2025年a)和Nano-Banana(Google,2026年)的图像编辑结果。 我们可以看到,Qwen-Image-Edit或Nano-Banana等大型图像编辑模型出现严重的幻觉和域位错位,使得文本指令难以遵循. 此外,对基于传播的图像编辑模型进行微调需要比标准VLM微调要多得多的数据,这阻断了它们适应与图像高效思维的道路.

blocks.en: Figure 3 also verifies the base model’s ability to adjust and construct useful instructions and high-quality SVGs through fine-tuning. We find various types of SVG drawing, including connecting two points, spanning a parallel/perpendicular line from a point, marking an intersection with a letter, and indexing important angles. The diversity of SVG behavior demonstrates the potential of VLMs as primitive vector graphics generators.
blocks.zh: 图3还通过微调验证基准模型调整和构建有用指令和高质量SVG的能力。 我们发现各种类型的SVG绘图,包括连接两个点,从一个点横跨一个平行/直线,标出一个与字母的交叉点,以及索引重要角度. SVG行为的多样性证明了VLM作为原始矢量图形生成器的潜力.

blocks.en: 4.4 Results
blocks.zh: 4.4 结果

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation study of the presence of solution images. All accuracies are calculated the same way as Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 表3:溶液图像存在的差化研究. 所有速率的计算方式与表2相同。

blocks.en: A summary of our experiments is shown in Table 2 . From the table, it is evident that SVGLM achieves better results on our benchmark with all three base models. While zero-shot and direct SFT on base models yield comparative results to GPT-4o, SVGLM surpasses both GPT-4o and open-source thinking-with-images baselines by a large margin. We find the following points worth noting: • GPT-4o with Qwen-Image-Edit as the reasoning medium does not improve over using GPT-4o only. As shown in Section 3 , this is due to the hallucination and low-quality outputs from Qwen-Image-Edit. • We notice a performance decrease on several entries between zero-shot and direct SFT. Admittedly, different models demonstrate different sensitivity levels to prompt structures and chain-of-thoughts in training, but only to a marginal error. Further discussion is done in Section 4.6 . Most experiments see a reasonable performance improvement on direct SFT, considering the reasoning abilities already present in selected models.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验摘要见表2。 从表中可以明显看出,SVGLM在我们的基准上用所有三个基本模型都取得了更好的成果. 虽然在基模型上零射和直接SFT产生比对GPT-4o的比较结果,但SVGLM比GPT-4o和开源思维-有图像基线都大相径庭. 我们发现以下几点值得注意: • GPT-4o与Quen-Image-Edit,因为推理介质并不比仅使用GPT-4o更好. 如第3节所示,这是由于Quen-Image-Edit的幻觉和低质量产出。 我们注意到,从零镜头到直接SFT的几个条目的性能下降。 诚然,不同的模型对培训中的即时结构和思维链表现出不同的敏感性水平,但只能对边际错误表现出不同的敏感性。 进一步讨论载于第4.6节。 大多数实验都认为,考虑到选定模型中已经存在的推理能力,直接SFT具有合理的性能改进.

blocks.en: GPT-4o with Qwen-Image-Edit as the reasoning medium does not improve over using GPT-4o only. As shown in Section 3 , this is due to the hallucination and low-quality outputs from Qwen-Image-Edit.
blocks.zh: GPT-4o带有Quen-Image-Edit,因为推理介质并不比仅使用GPT-4o更好. 如第3节所示,这是由于Quen-Image-Edit的幻觉和低质量产出。

blocks.en: We notice a performance decrease on several entries between zero-shot and direct SFT. Admittedly, different models demonstrate different sensitivity levels to prompt structures and chain-of-thoughts in training, but only to a marginal error. Further discussion is done in Section 4.6 . Most experiments see a reasonable performance improvement on direct SFT, considering the reasoning abilities already present in selected models.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,从零镜头到直接SFT的几个条目的性能下降。 诚然,不同的模型对培训中的即时结构和思维链表现出不同的敏感性水平,但只能对边际错误表现出不同的敏感性。 进一步讨论载于第4.6节。 大多数实验都认为,考虑到选定模型中已经存在的推理能力,直接SFT具有合理的性能改进.

blocks.en: Overall, we see SVGLM with a significant boost of 8 % 8\% over zero-shot and 6.5 % 6.5\% over direct SFT. It also beats GPT-4o and the two think-with-images baselines.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们看到SVGLM在零射线上大幅提升8%,在直接SFT上大幅提升6.5%6.5%. 它也比GPT-4o和两个有思维的图像基线.

blocks.en: 4.5 Generalization to grounded reasoning
blocks.zh: 4.5 概括为有根据的推理

blocks.en: Further experiments are conducted to showcase SVG’s power in grounded reasoning, where the answer must ground on specific pixels or regions in the image. We select 30,000 random samples from Visual Genome ( Krishna et al., 2016 ) , consisting of visual QA pairs concerning specific objects in the image. The bounding box in each sample is converted so that the rendered SVG contains a visible box on top of the original image. This selected dataset is used to reproduce the whole training process of SVGLM.
blocks.zh: 进行进一步实验以展示SVG在基于推理中的力量,其中答案必须建立在图像中的特定像素或区域上. 我们从视觉基因组(Krishna等人,2016年)中选择了30,000个随机样本,由图像中特定物体的视觉QA对组成. 每个样本中的边框被转换,使制成的SVG在原始图像上方包含一个可见的框. 这个选定的数据集用于复制SVGLM的整个训练过程.

blocks.en: We then test our trained models on POPE ( Li et al., 2023a ) , a dataset to evaluate vision-language models’ hallucination. POPE’s samples are hard to answer if not concretely grounded on specific objects in the image, making them a suitable candidate to solve with our canvas-based method. Results are in Table 4 , with all three models seeing improvement from vanilla SFT. Although grounded reasoning’s used SVGs are simple and equivalent to explicitly drawing boxes, model can benefit from the generalizability of SVGs to adapt to broader tasks and shapes.
blocks.zh: 然后测试我们训练有素的POPE模型(Li等人,2023a), POPE的样本很难回答, 结果见表4,所有三种模式都比香草SFT有所改善。 虽然基于推理使用的SVG简单,与明确绘制框相当,但模型可以从SVG的通俗性中获益,以适应更广泛的任务和形状.

blocks.en: Table 4: Evaluation results of grounded reasoning with POPE benchmark
blocks.zh: 表4:以POPE基准为基础推理的评价结果

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.6 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct several ablation studies to strengthen the rationale of the SVGLM pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了若干次消毒研究,以加强SVGLM管道的原理。

blocks.en: Model choices Our three models are chosen as representatives of different model families and training strategies. We notice serious training data contamination starting from Qwen3-VL-8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and InternVL-3.5-8B ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . However, we found that: zero-shot inference of Qwen3-VL-8B achieves 30.8% on the benchmark, while pure SFT on the same set of prompts scored 22.8% which is lower than zero-shot; on one category of the dataset, Trigonometry, zero-shot model has 49.2% accuracy, significantly higher than GPT-4o and SFT results, which yields around 20%. This performance degradation suggests potential data contamination with the testing data. Therefore, we choose Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL-3-8B as they are among the most powerful open-sourced vision language models by the time the benchmark was released at the 7B scale.
blocks.zh: 模式选择 我们的三种模式被选为不同模式家庭和培训战略的代表。 我们注意到从Qune3-VL-8B(Bai等人,2025a)和InternVL-3.5-8B(Wang等人,2025b)开始的严重训练数据污染。 然而,我们发现: Qwen3-VL-8B的零射法推论在基准上达到了30.8%,而同一组提示器上的纯SFT得分为22.8%,低于零射法;在一类数据集中,Trigonometry,零射法模型的精度为49.2%,明显高于GPT-4o和SFT的结果,结果为20%左右. 这种性能退化表明,测试数据可能污染数据。 因此,我们选择了Quen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL-3-8B,因为它们在基准以7B尺度发布时已经属于最强大的开源视觉语言模型.

blocks.en: Is auxiliary images necessary? This question arises from our benchmark naturally, since the difficulty of samples with ground truth solution images is an apparent upper bound of how SVGs can perform given infinite budget of text-based inference. To quantitatively analyze this, we first generate ground truth image editing instructions using the question image and solution image pairs; then, we test zero-shot performances of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on MathCanvas-Bench, given both images alongside the generated text instruction. Table 3 illustrates the impact of solution images’ presence on zero-shot Qwen2.5-VL-7B model. It is evident that the questions do appear much simpler to multi-modal agents when come with the solution image.
blocks.zh: 辅助图像有必要吗? 这个问题自然产生于我们的基准,因为用地面真理解决方案图像的样本的难度是SVG如何进行无限预算的文本推论的明显上限。 为了从数量上分析这一点,我们首先利用问题图像和溶液图像对生成地面真像编辑指令;然后,我们在MathCanvas-Bench上测试Quen2.5-VL-7B的零镜头性能,同时将两种图像与生成的文本指令同时进行. 表3说明了溶液图像的存在对零射出Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型的影响。 显然,对于多式联运代理商来说,问题似乎要简单得多。

blocks.en: Ablation of Framework Components. We verify the contributions of all components within our SVGLM framework by isolating the effects of SVG generation and rendering. To maintain consistency with the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) baselines, we utilize Gemini exclusively to generate the SVGs, while the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is generated by GPT-5 across the same set of prompts. However, enforcing perfectly identical prompts across all configurations is not strictly plausible; the full CoT unavoidably incorporates visual information from the rendered SVG. Consequently, omitting the SVG removes crucial context that standard SFT relies on.
blocks.zh: 框架组成部分的参照。 我们通过隔离SVG生成和渲染的效果,验证我们SVGLM框架内所有组件的贡献. 为了与受监督的微调(SFT)基线保持一致,我们只利用双子座生成SVG,而思维链(COT)推理则由GPT-5通过同一套提示生成. 然而,在所有配置中执行完全相同的提示并非完全合理;完整的CoT不可避免地包含从制成的SVG中获取的视觉信息。 因此,略去SVG会删除标准SFT所依赖的关键上下文.

blocks.en: To decouple these mechanisms and strengthen our argument, we evaluate models under three distinct settings: the full SVGLM framework, SVGLM without the rendered SVG feedback (forcing the model to output the solution based only on the generated SVG code), and SVGLM without any SVG generation or rendering. As Table 5 indicates, thinking with SVGs (w/o SVG render) already shows improvements over settings lacking both generation and rendering. Incorporating the rendered images back into the context pushes the performance even further. For instance, removing both SVG generation and rendering on Qwen2.5-VL significantly degrades performance, demonstrating that both the generation and rendering phases are crucial to our method. While LLaVa-Next sees a comparatively smaller boost due to its limited capacity in multi-image understanding, all models achieve their highest performance with the full SVGLM equipped. This solidifies our argument that SVGLM’s dual mechanism of creation and visual reflection fundamentally charges VLM reasoning abilities.
blocks.zh: 为了解析这些机制和加强我们的论点,我们在三个不同的设置下评价模型:完整的SVGLM框架,没有渲染的SVG反馈的SVGLM(强制模型只根据生成的SVG代码输出解决方案),没有任何SVG生成或渲染的SVGLM. 如表5所示,与SVGs(w/o SVG 渲染)的思考已经表明,相对于缺乏生成和渲染的设置而言,已有改进。 将渲染的图像回放到上下文中,使性能更进一步推进. 例如,移除SVG生成和在Quen2.5-VL上的渲染都会显著降低性能,表明生成和渲染阶段对我们的方法都至关重要。 虽然LLaVa-Next由于在多图像理解方面的能力有限而看到了相对较小的提升,但所有型号都通过配备了完整的SVGLM来实现最高性能. 这证明了我们的论点,即SVGLM的创造和视觉反射的双重机制从根本上将VLM推理能力赋予了.

blocks.en: Table 5: Ablation study verifying all framework components. All figures represent the weighted score on MathCanvas-Bench. w/o SVG render forces the model to output the answer after writing the SVG code, without the rendered image as feedback. w/o SVG gen. & render represents the baseline without any SVG assistance.
blocks.zh: 表5:核实所有框架组成部分的关联性研究。 所有数字都代表了MathCanvas-Bench的加权得分. w/o SVG使模型在写入SVG代码后强制输出答案,而不将渲染的图像作为反馈. w/o SVG gen. & 渲染代表基线,没有任何SVG协助.

blocks.en: Effect of different prompts We assess the outcome of different reasoning densities in our curated dataset, namely: No reasoning only keeps the instruction for the SVG as well as steps to solve the original problem; Concise gives moderate steps of reasoning; Complete is a detailed, step-by-step reasoning on both SVG generation and question answering. Table 6 shows the experimental results on the same benchmark. clearly indicating the impact of prompt patterns in SFT training. Presumably, models with stronger reasoning abilities will prefer shorter answers as SFT, as longer prompts are likely inconsistent with the models’ internal knowledge, thus more resources are used in shifting the distribution of text generation instead of focusing on answering correctly. However, we mark that whichever set of reasoning densities produce a significant increase in weighted accuracies of our benchmark.
blocks.zh: 不同提示的效果 我们评估我们整理的数据集中不同推理密度的结果,即: 没有推理只保留SVG的指令以及解决原始问题的步骤; 简明给出了适度的推理步骤; complete是SVG生成和问题回答上的详细,分步骤的推理. 表6显示了同一基准的实验结果。 明确显示SFT培训中迅速模式的影响。 假设推理能力较强的模型会倾向于像SFT那样更短的答案,因为较长的提示可能与模型的内部知识不一致,因此在转移文本生成的分布时会使用更多的资源,而不是专注于正确的回答. 然而,我们指出,无论何种推理密度,都大大增加了我们基准的加权速度。

blocks.en: Table 6: Ablation study of reasoning density. All figures are the weighted score of MathCanvas-Bench.
blocks.zh: 表6:推理密度的偏差研究. 所有数字均为MathCanvas-Bench的加权得分.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present SVGLM, a paradigm to boost multi-modal agents with the ability to think with renderable programs, as well as a large fine-tuning dataset of 8K high-quality question-SVG pairs. We show that with proper tool-calling integration, multi-modal agents with weak reasoning abilities can learn to think with vector graphics as renderable programs, exhibiting better performance than other thinking with images baselines as well as standard fine-tuned VLMs. On the other hand, SVGLM is suitable for Document QA and grounded reasoning tasks as well, where SVG can be used to draw charts and plot important entities. The success in both math and spatial reasoning demonstrate the potential of SVGLM as an easy and elegant solution to boosting smaller models’ reasoning abilities.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们呈现了SVGLM,一种能与可渲染程序一起思考的促进多模式代理的范式,以及8K高品质问题-SVG对的大型微调数据集. 我们显示,通过适当的工具调用集成,推理能力弱的多式联运代理能够学习用矢量图形作为可渲染的程序来思考,比用图像基线以及标准微调的VLM进行其他思维表现出更好的性能. 另一方面,SVGLM也适合文档QA和基于推理的任务,其中SVG可以用来绘制图表和绘制重要实体. 数学和空间推理的成功表明了SVGLM作为提升较小模型推理能力的简单而优雅的解决办法的潜力.

blocks.en: Limitations Due to lack of compute resources and paid API requests, we’re not able to verify our results in larger models and larger SVG datasets. We will try our best to scale up SVGLM, as well as applying inference-time scaling methods in subsequent works.
blocks.zh: 限制 由于缺乏计算资源和支付API请求,我们无法在更大的模型和更大的SVG数据集中验证结果. 我们将尽力扩大SVGLM,并在以后的作品中应用推论时间缩放方法.

blocks.en: Your task is to identify the difference between the Question image and solution image based on the instructions. You should generate a transparent overlay in SVG format. blocks.en: Appendix B Training setup
blocks.zh: 附录B 培训设置

blocks.en: We adopted LLaMa-Factory ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) as the training base for LLaVa-Next-Mistral-7B ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025b ) and InternVL-3-8B ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . Our system for training has Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8468 CPU and 8 Nvidia H100 GPUs. We use the full fine-tune setting that tunes all language model parameters while freezing all three VLMs’ vision towers and multi-modal projectors. We use cosine learning rate scheduler with 10 − 5 10^{-5} learning rate. All models are trained for 3 3 epochs under each setting, with per-device batch size 1 1 (effectively batch size 8 8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们采用LLaMa-Factory(郑等人,2024年)作为LLaVa-Next-Mistral-7B(刘等人,2024年),Quen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct(Bai等人,2025b)和InternVL-3-8B(朱等人,2025年)的培训基地. 我们的训练系统有Intel(R)Xeon(R)Platinum 8468 CPU和8 Nvidia H100 GPU. 我们使用完全的微调设置来调和所有语言模型参数,同时冻结所有三个VLM的视觉塔和多模式投影仪。 我们使用余弦学习率计程器,学习率为10 - 5 10 - 5。 所有型号在每个设置下共培训3个3个世纪,每个装置的批号为1 1(有效批号为8 8 ).
